title: Original Work-Tape Readings
statement: Let $M$ be a Turing machine with $k$ work tapes and Boolean tape symbols, and let $x$ be a Boolean input with configuration $c$. For any function $g$ assigning an optional Boolean symbol to each of three additional tapes, the symbols currently read on the first $k$ tapes of the combined $k+3$ tape collection are exactly the symbols read by the work tapes of $c$.
hypotheses_covered: $M$ is a finite Turing machine over Boolean symbols
$g$ assigns an optional Boolean symbol to each of three additional tapes
